title: Phishing Macro Execution Chain
description: Detects Office applications spawning PowerShell or WScript after macro-enabled document execution — common phishing payload delivery chain.
kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ('winword.exe', 'excel.exe', 'powerpnt.exe', 'outlook.exe')
| where FileName in~ ('powershell.exe', 'pwsh.exe', 'wscript.exe', 'cscript.exe', 'cmd.exe')
| extend ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ParentCmd, ChildCmd
| order by Timestamp desc

title: LOLBin Execution via Certutil / Msiexec / Regsvr32
description: Identifies living-off-the-land binary abuse in process creation events (Event ID 4688) for download, install, or DLL registration patterns.
kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where EventData has_any ('certutil', 'msiexec', 'regsvr32')
| extend ProcessName = tostring(EventData.ProcessName)
| extend CommandLine = tostring(EventData.CommandLine)
| where ProcessName has_any ('certutil.exe', 'msiexec.exe', 'regsvr32.exe')
    or CommandLine has_any ('-urlcache', '-verifyctl', '-quiet', '/i http', '/s /u', '/i:')
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Scheduled Task Creation and Modification
description: Surfaces new or modified scheduled tasks (4698/4702) that adversaries use for persistence and delayed execution.
kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID in (4698, 4702)
| extend TaskName = tostring(EventData.TaskName)
| extend TaskContent = tostring(EventData.TaskContent)
| extend SubjectUserName = tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName)
| where TaskName !contains '\\Microsoft\\'
| project TimeGenerated, EventID, Computer, SubjectUserName, TaskName, TaskContent
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Pass-the-Hash NTLM Lateral Movement
description: Correlates network logon type 3 with NTLM authentication to detect PtH-style lateral movement across workstations and servers.
kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4624
| extend LogonType = toint(EventData.LogonType)
| extend AuthenticationPackageName = tostring(EventData.AuthenticationPackageName)
| extend IpAddress = tostring(EventData.IpAddress)
| extend TargetUserName = tostring(EventData.TargetUserName)
| where LogonType == 3
| where AuthenticationPackageName =~ 'NTLM'
| where IpAddress !in ('-', '::1', '127.0.0.1')
| summarize LogonCount = count(), DistinctHosts = dcount(Computer) by TargetUserName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where LogonCount > 5
| order by LogonCount desc

title: DNS Beaconing — Long Subdomain Queries
description: Flags unusually long DNS subdomain labels indicative of DNS tunneling or C2 beaconing via ASim DNS activity logs.
kql:
ASimDnsActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventResult == 'Success'
| extend SubdomainLength = strlen(tostring(DnsQuery))
| where SubdomainLength > 50
| extend LabelCount = array_length(split(DnsQuery, '.'))
| where LabelCount > 5
| summarize QueryCount = count(), AvgLength = avg(SubdomainLength) by DnsQuery, SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where QueryCount > 10
| order by AvgLength desc

title: Large Outbound Data Transfer
description: Combines Trend Micro Deep Security and CommonSecurityLog firewall/proxy events to detect high-volume outbound transfers.
kql:
let TrendMicroTransfers = TrendMicroDeepSecurity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where EventID == 600
    | extend BytesOut = tolong(BytesSent)
    | where BytesOut > 100000000;
let FirewallTransfers = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where DeviceVendor has_any ('Palo Alto', 'Fortinet', 'Check Point', 'Cisco')
    | extend BytesOut = tolong(SentBytes)
    | where BytesOut > 100000000;
union TrendMicroTransfers, FirewallTransfers
| summarize TotalBytes = sum(BytesOut), EventCount = count() by SourceIP, DestinationIP, DestinationPort, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where TotalBytes > 500000000
| order by TotalBytes desc

title: Brute Force Then Successful Logon
description: Correlates multiple failed logons (4625) followed by a successful logon (4624) on the same account and host within a short window.
kql:
let FailedLogons = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4625
    | extend TargetUserName = tostring(EventData.TargetUserName)
    | extend IpAddress = tostring(EventData.IpAddress)
    | summarize FailedCount = count() by Computer, TargetUserName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m);
let SuccessLogons = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4624
    | extend TargetUserName = tostring(EventData.TargetUserName)
    | extend IpAddress = tostring(EventData.IpAddress)
    | extend LogonType = toint(EventData.LogonType)
    | where LogonType in (2, 10)
    | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, IpAddress;
FailedLogons
| join kind=inner SuccessLogons on Computer, TargetUserName, IpAddress
| where SuccessTime between (TimeGenerated .. (TimeGenerated + 30m))
| where FailedCount >= 5
| project TimeGenerated, SuccessTime, Computer, TargetUserName, IpAddress, FailedCount
| order by FailedCount desc

title: PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
description: Detects PowerShell invocations with encoded commands and attempts base64 decode of payload for analyst review.
kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ('powershell.exe', 'pwsh.exe')
| where ProcessCommandLine has '-enc' or ProcessCommandLine has '-EncodedCommand'
| extend EncodedPayload = extract(@'-(?:enc|EncodedCommand)\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)', 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend DecodedCommand = iif(isnotempty(EncodedPayload), replace_string(tostring(base64_decode_tostring(EncodedPayload)), '\0', ''), '')
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine, DecodedCommand
| order by Timestamp desc

title: LSASS Access / Credential Dumping
description: Identifies processes accessing LSASS memory or triggering credential dumping alerts in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint device events.
kql:
DeviceEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ('OpenProcessApiCall', 'SensitiveApiCall', 'LsassMemoryRead')
    or InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ('mimikatz', 'procdump', 'comsvcs.dll')
| where FileName =~ 'lsass.exe' or TargetImageFileName =~ 'lsass.exe'
    or AdditionalFields has 'lsass'
| extend AccessingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName
| extend CommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, AccessingProcess, CommandLine, ReportId
| order by Timestamp desc

title: New Local Administrator Account Created
description: Detects local account creation (4720) followed by addition to the Administrators group (4732).
kql:
let AccountCreated = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4720
    | extend NewAccount = tostring(EventData.TargetUserName)
    | extend Creator = tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName)
    | project CreateTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, NewAccount, Creator;
let AdminAdded = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4732
    | extend MemberName = tostring(EventData.MemberName)
    | extend GroupName = tostring(EventData.TargetUserName)
    | where GroupName contains 'Administrators'
    | project AddTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, MemberName;
AccountCreated
| join kind=inner AdminAdded on Computer
| where MemberName contains NewAccount
| where AddTime between (CreateTime .. (CreateTime + 1h))
| project CreateTime, AddTime, Computer, NewAccount, Creator
| order by CreateTime desc

title: Shadow Copy Deletion Pre-Ransomware
description: Detects vssadmin/wmic/bcdedit commands used to delete shadow copies before ransomware deployment.
kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend CommandLine = tostring(EventData.CommandLine)
| extend ProcessName = tostring(EventData.ProcessName)
| where ProcessName in~ ('vssadmin.exe', 'wmic.exe', 'bcdedit.exe', 'powershell.exe')
| where CommandLine has_any (
    'delete shadows', 'shadowcopy delete', 'Win32_ShadowCopy',
    'recoveryenabled no', 'ignoreallfailures'
)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = EventData.SubjectUserName, ProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Suspicious Outbound DNS TXT Record Queries
description: Highlights abnormal volumes of DNS TXT record lookups to external domains — often used for C2 or data staging.
kql:
ASimDnsActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where DnsQueryTypeName =~ 'TXT' or DnsResponseName has 'txt'
| where EventResult == 'Success'
| where DnsQuery !endswith '.internal' and DnsQuery !endswith '.local'
| summarize TxtQueryCount = count(), DistinctDomains = dcount(DnsQuery) by SrcIpAddr, DnsQuery, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where TxtQueryCount > 20
| order by TxtQueryCount desc
